'''Mayumi Iizuka''' (Japanese: '''飯塚雅弓''' ''Iizuka Mayumi'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}. Her most famous role is that of {{an|Misty}}.

==Biography==
Iizuka was born on January 3, 1977 in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}. She began her career as an actor when she was three years old, but after she got her first voice acting role in the anime ''Omoide Poroporo'', she went into a voice acting and singing career. She joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} at the very start of {{aniseries|OS}} and voiced a number of characters, most notably {{an|Misty}}. Iizuka has said that out of all her Pokémon roles, Misty is most like her. She got the part after the director told her to be herself during her audition.
